analysis.reasonEn: Previous buy decision maintained. RSI at 56.4, continuing upward momentum after exiting oversold. MACD histogram shows improvement. Higher Low pattern formed with 5-day low ($57.59) at or above 20-day low ($57.59). Weekly RSI at 57.5, near the upper end of neutral. ADX at 26.8 indicates a clear trend. 4-hour RSI at 63.7, entering bullish territory. Aligns with market-wide QQQ +3.4% surge.
